lead.event: Rupiah reaches successive record lows in November 2026
lead.headline: Rupiah sets another November record low at Rp18,270 per US dollar
lead.blurb: The rupiah hit an intraday record of Rp18,270 per US dollar and closed at Rp18,258 on 16 November, down 0.35%. Its previous record was Rp18,239 on 12 November, after a 13 November close of Rp18,206. The currency had depreciated 2.9% since 16 September and 8.51% year to date amid a strong US dollar, elevated US yields and domestic risk concerns. Bank Indonesia’s Board of Governors meets on 17–18 November.
lead.copy_decision: rewritten: 1 new articles with a new fact: The rupiah hit Rp18,270 intraday and closed at Rp18,258 on 16 November 2026.

market_structure_policy.event: Mining stocks fall after Prabowo calls for 70% of mining profits for the state
market_structure_policy.headline: Mining stocks fall as Prabowo seeks at least 70% of mining profits for state
market_structure_policy.blurb: PAM Mineral led losses, down 6.98%, as coal, mineral and metal stocks declined. Prabowo also floated state share ownership in mining companies and directed that mining exports use a single channel.

market_structure_policy.event: FTSE Russell removes 14 Indonesian stocks from December indexes
market_structure_policy.headline: FTSE schedules 14 Indonesian stocks, including BRIS, for December index removal
market_structure_policy.blurb: All 14 are classified as high shareholding concentration, and the changes take effect at the start of trading on 21 December. Kiwoom Sekuritas expects passive-fund selling to concentrate before the close on 18 December, with nominal selling pressure greatest for BRIS.
market_structure_policy.copy_decision: rewritten: 2 new articles with a new fact: Kiwoom expects passive-fund selling to concentrate before the close on 18 December 2026.

other.event: ULTJ sets cum date for additional Rp100 per share dividend
other.headline: ULTJ sets 16 November cum date for additional Rp100-per-share dividend
other.blurb: Ultrajaya’s additional Rp1 trillion cash dividend for fiscal 2025 was approved at an extraordinary shareholders meeting on 6 November. It will be funded from unrestricted retained earnings, which stood at Rp7.5 trillion at year-end 2025; the company previously paid a final dividend of Rp130 per share on 22 May.

earnings_guidance.event: Astra sets 2030 targets and asset-reallocation strategy at Investor Day
earnings_guidance.headline: ASII sets 2030 targets and plans around Rp10 trillion asset reallocation
earnings_guidance.blurb: Astra has spent around Rp14 trillion on share buybacks since November 2025. It targets earnings per share of Rp1,150–Rp1,200 by 2030, excluding non-recurring items, minimum return on equity of 15%, and around Rp10 trillion in net-asset reallocation based on December 2025 book values.
earnings_guidance.copy_decision: rewritten: 4 new articles with a new fact: Astra has spent around Rp14 trillion on share buybacks since November 2025.

earnings_guidance.event: Antam reports nine-month 2026 net profit up 46% to Rp9.7 trillion
earnings_guidance.headline: ANTM reports nine-month net profit up 46% to Rp9.7 trillion
earnings_guidance.blurb: Antam's revenue rose 23% to Rp88.48 trillion, with precious metals and refining contributing Rp68.8 trillion, about 78% of the total. Gold sales reached 25.2 tons worth Rp68.4 trillion, up 17%.

earnings_guidance.event: Mirae Asset raises its target price and profit forecasts for Indo Tambangraya Megah
earnings_guidance.headline: Mirae Asset raises ITMG target price to Rp26,520 and profit forecasts
earnings_guidance.blurb: Mirae Asset Sekuritas lifted its target from Rp25,000, implying 8.9% upside, and kept a hold recommendation on Indo Tambangraya Megah. It raised its net profit projections by 15.6% for 2026 and 5.9% for 2027.

earnings_guidance.event: OJK reports nine-month multifinance industry net profit growth
earnings_guidance.headline: OJK reports nine-month multifinance profit up 22.8% to Rp19.82 trillion
earnings_guidance.blurb: BFI Finance posted net profit of Rp1.31 trillion, up 11.96% year on year, while Adira Finance earned Rp1.69 trillion, up 55.04%, through September 2026. Industry outstanding financing rose 2.21% to Rp518.34 trillion, and gross non-performing financing improved to 2.98% from 3.04% in August.

deals_control.event: COIN signs agreement to acquire 10% of MIG for Rp200 billion
deals_control.headline: COIN signs conditional deal for 10% of MIG for Rp200 billion
deals_control.blurb: COIN shares rose 20.30% in the first trading session after the announcement. The agreement, signed on 13 November, covers 1,223,435 newly issued MIG Series B shares, with completion still subject to the agreement.
deals_control.copy_decision: rewritten: 2 new articles with a new fact: COIN shares rose 20.30% in the first trading session after the announcement.

deals_control.event: HRME settles dispute over The Hermitage Jakarta hotel auction
deals_control.headline: HRME settles Hermitage hotel auction dispute after Rp489.58 billion asset transfer
deals_control.blurb: Menteng Heritage Realty says auction winner Hotel Menteng Jakarta took over the hotel and land, with a net book value of Rp489.58 billion, or 60% of assets on 30 September 2026. The transfer offset Rp205.35 billion owed to Bank Mandiri, leaving no bank debt, though the company still bears the loss and is reviewing strategic alternatives.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: ANDA plans IPO to raise up to Rp316.76 billion
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: ANDA plans IPO to raise up to Rp316.76 billion
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Andalan Artha Primanusa is offering up to 1.67 billion new shares, equal to 25.1% of its fully paid-up capital, at Rp 158-189 per share. It plans to allocate 65% of proceeds to working capital and around Rp107 billion to debt repayment. The offering runs through 17 November, with a potential listing on 1 December.
